title: Scene
description: A single scene. Usually authored as Markdown with optional frontmatter; this schema describes the frontmatter shape.

summary.description: One-line summary for the storyboard view.

location.description: Where the scene takes place. Free text or reference to a place record.

presentNpcs.description: NPCs likely to be present. References by name or id.

presentThreats.description: Bestiary references for any threats present.

expectedDuration.description: Estimated wall-clock duration at the table. Free text.

mood.description: Tone the DM should aim for. Free text or one-word tag.

rolls.description: Anticipated rolls or moves this scene typically prompts. DM aide-memoire.
